title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초1 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ PassOff 092 ]

blocks.text: My family moved to the big city because of my father’s company and for us to receive a better education.
When I was young, my father’s company went bankrupt, so we had to move several more times.
Our family’s financial situation was not very stable, so my mother had to work, too.
I grew up well taken care of because even though my mother had to work, she still managed to take good care of me and my brothers and sisters.
